pairs.difference: Both whistles show the top opening, side chamber and mouth in a coherent mild three-quarter view. The ring turns differently, but neither camera looks anomalous.
A's horn extends almost sideways with little recession. B's tubing runs diagonally away from the bell toward a much smaller mouthpiece, giving the instrument stronger foreshortening.
pairs.fix: Show the horn more side-on, with the bell and mouthpiece at nearly the same depth and the long tube almost horizontal.

pairs.difference: Both show a shallow oval cup opening and a broader saucer ellipse from a consistent slightly elevated camera. The different cup bases do not establish a viewpoint fault.
Both baskets use a mild elevated view, with the front apples overlapping the rear apples and the basket front hiding their lower halves. Neither shows a clear spatial inconsistency.
A exposes a clear oval opening above the barrel, consistent with the visible deck. B's opening becomes a narrow slit although the surrounding deck and railing still show substantial upper surfaces.
pairs.fix: Raise the view of the barrel slightly so its open top forms a clear shallow oval, matching the view down onto the deck.

pairs.difference: A shows the taxi from near headlight height, with a relatively shallow view over the hood. B reveals more hood and roof from above, making the car read from a higher camera.
pairs.fix: Lower the camera toward headlight height and show less of the hood and roof, keeping a mild three-quarter view.

pairs.difference: A frames the tent with nearby trunks and a simpler distant row of pines. B places numerous distinct tree trunks and crowns at successive distances behind the tent, creating a deeper forest corridor.
pairs.fix: Keep the tent between two nearby framing trees, with a simpler distant row of pines and fewer separate trees in the middle distance.

pairs.difference: A shows the pot mostly from the front with a shallow view into the soup. B looks farther down into the pot and exposes the full stone-ring footprint beneath it, adding a pronounced foreground layer.
pairs.fix: Lower the camera so the soup opening is a shallower oval and the fire sits beneath the pot without a broad stone ring spreading toward the viewer.

pattern: Generated cards tend to raise the camera, strengthen recession, or add distinct foreground and background layers beyond the real cards' milder spatial reading.
